welcome.title: Welcome to {appName}
welcome.body:
{appName} is a free workspace for **game design documents**.

:::callout idea
Type `/` anywhere to insert headings, to-dos, toggles, callouts, tables and more.
:::

## Try it

- [ ] Write your game's one-sentence pitch
- [ ] List three design pillars
- [ ] Describe the core loop

:::toggle Where is my work stored?
In local mode everything stays in this browser (IndexedDB). Later you can connect a GitHub repository so your team can work on the same GDD.
:::

github.repoHint: Stored in this GitHub repository. Opens on github.com.
github.connectDescription: Your pages become Markdown files in a repository you own. Everyone you add to the repo can open the workspace.
github.openDescription: Pick a repository that already contains a workspace.
github.unconfigured: GitHub sign-in is not set up on this server.
github.unconfiguredHint: The person running PageHut sets this up once; users never handle keys. On your own computer, the button below does it in one click.
github.signInWhy: Sign in with GitHub to store this workspace in a repository and share it with your team.
github.privacy1: Documents go straight from your browser to GitHub; this server never stores them.
github.privacy2: The app can only reach repositories you explicitly install it on.
github.noRepos: No repositories found. Install the app on a repository first.
github.missingRepo: Don't see your repository? Install the app on it
github.connectWarning: All pages will be committed to {repo} in {folder}.

errors.hasWorkspace: This repository already contains a workspace. Use “Open from GitHub” instead.
errors.notWorkspace: This repository has no workspace yet. Use “Save to GitHub” from a local workspace instead.
errors.offline: You're offline. Your work is saved in this browser; try again when you're back online.
errors.rateLimited: GitHub's rate limit was reached. Try again after {time}.
errors.signedOut: Your GitHub session expired. Sign in again; nothing local is lost.
errors.noAccess: The app can't access this repository. Check that it's installed on it and that you can push.
errors.generic: Something went wrong talking to GitHub. Your local work is safe.
errors.signInFailed: GitHub sign-in failed. Please try again.

github.chooseReposHint: Choose which repositories PageHut may use. GitHub will bring you back here afterwards.
github.saveHereInstead: Save this workspace to this repository instead
github.openHereInstead: Open the workspace from this repository instead
github.folderHint: Recommended for game repos: PageHut only touches this folder, never your Unity/Unreal project. Leave empty to use the repository root.
github.autoMoved: Your GDD in {repo} now lives in the GDD/ folder. Nothing else in the repository changed.

share.title: Share with your team
share.description: Team access is GitHub access: whoever can push to the repository can edit the workspace.
share.step1: Add teammates as collaborators on the repository:
share.step2: They accept the invitation on GitHub.
share.step3: They open {app} and choose “Open from GitHub”, then {repo}.
share.permissions: Read access lets people view; write access lets them edit. Per-page permissions aren't possible on a Git repository.
share.manageInstall: Manage which repositories the app can access
share.localOnly: This workspace is only in this browser. Save it to GitHub first to share it.

sync.conflict: {count, plural, one {# page needs your decision} other {# pages need your decision}}

moveFolder.title: Move the workspace to another folder
moveFolder.description: One commit moves the workspace files. Nothing else in the repository changes.
moveFolder.hint: Use a folder outside Assets/ (e.g. GDD) so Unity ignores it.
moveFolder.taken: That folder already contains a workspace.
moveFolder.remoteChanged: Someone changed the workspace files on GitHub. Sync first (comes with P3), then try again.
moveFolder.invalid: Please use a simple folder name like GDD or docs/gdd.

conflict.message: This page was also changed on GitHub, in the same place you edited. Nothing is lost: your text is in the editor, theirs is kept aside.
conflict.compareTitle: Your version and the GitHub version
conflict.compareDescription: Lines only in your version are marked “Yours”; lines only in the GitHub version are marked “On GitHub”.
conflict.confirmMine: Keep your version? It replaces the GitHub version, which stays in the page history.
conflict.confirmTheirs: Keep the GitHub version? Your unsent text on this page will be replaced.

history.title: Page history
history.description: Every saved version of this page on GitHub. Restoring a version saves it as a new change; nothing is rewritten.
history.empty: No history yet. It starts with the first sync.
